name: chsql
description: ClickHouse SQL compatibility for DuckDB: 100+ macros and table functions that mirror ClickHouse's function names and semantics — generateUUIDv4, splitByChar, toYear, arrayJoin, IPv4StringToNum, numbers(), system tables, and more.

cta.title: Run ClickHouse SQL on DuckDB
cta.description: Install chsql to port ClickHouse queries to DuckDB with minimal rewriting — the macros keep ClickHouse's spelling and behavior so your existing SQL just runs.

quickStart.title: ClickHouse-style helpers — UUIDs and string splitting
quickStart.sql: SELECT generateUUIDv4() AS id, splitByChar(',', 'a,b,c') AS parts;

quickStart.title: Date and type conversions that match ClickHouse names
quickStart.sql: SELECT toYear(DATE '2026-06-14') AS year, toString(42) AS s, toInt64OrZero('NaN') AS safe;
